name: Phoenix Rebirth #87 — Shiva & Parvati, Union of Creation and Destruction
description: He is dissolution. She is sustaining grace. Shiva bears the fire that ends illusion, while Parvati embodies devotion, fertility, and the power through which life continues. In Hindu cosmology they are not separate forces but an eternal union: destruction not as chaos, but as the clearing required for renewal. In their Phoenix incarnation, flame becomes balance and balance becomes sacred motion. They rise as one axis of existence — where death prepares life, where tenderness tempers power, and where rebirth is not accident but cosmic law.
